items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: with Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and Horace Silver's group and Cannonball

ctx.x: And then, of course, came what they called Funky Music, with Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and Horace Silver's group and Cannonball, and like that. How did you hear that...

I didn't hear that too good. I didn't hear that too good. Since Bird, I haven't heard anything really, you know, as magnificent as that. Except maybe the two newest trumpet players that come on the scene. But I can't find out nothin' that they play that I really like, so I
